scope: Stipulated finite classical edge scores, controlled Bernoulli measurements and independently assumed kernel bound. No real subjects, neuroscience, phenomenology, data or quantum-gravity derivation.

illustrative_measurement_budget.assumptions: Cellwise iid bounded outcomes, controlled backgrounds, independently justified deterministic bias bounds and true graph-drift bound; correlations across cells allowed by union bound.

independent_horizon_assumption.scope: Separate uniform kernel assumption; graph weights and graph estimation do not establish it.
